nom: fresh Black Tea Anti-Aging Eye Cream with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix

avis.texte: Not impressed. I have several other Fresh products that I really like, but this eye cream was very disappointing. It's thick and tacky and not a very appealing color, does not seem very hydrating at all. I won't be purchasing it again.

This was so not worth the price. I used this whole tub but it did nothing for my eyes. I could only use it at night because it's so flaky and "pills" after you put it on. It does that whether you use other products or not. It does not get absorbed at all and literally had no benefits/pros.

avis.titre: Creme Ancienne eye cream is far better
avis.texte: I tried this because Fresh has been sold out of Creme Ancienne eye cream for a long time. Even though the Creme Ancienne eye cream is at least twice as expensive, it is worth it. BlackTea Anti-Aging eye cream does nothing for the area under my eyes and it has a flaky residue. The Creme Ancienne leaves a dewy, soft look. Please bring back Creme Ancienne.

This cream really made a difference for my tired looking eyes and undereye circles. It's thick and really moisturizing. I felt like it relieved puffiness and minimized the dark undereye circles. I'm glad I purchased and will continue to use.

avis.titre: Sits on top of skin and flakes off after it dries
avis.texte: I cannot fathom why this eye cream is so well rated. It goes on very nicely, but then an hour or two later you'll notice white gunk on your eye lashes and realize it's the cream, or worse, you'll go to put on your makeup and suddenly you realize there is a bunch of gunk peeling off your skin and building up in obvious clumps under your makeup. It just does not actually dissolve into the skin. For the price it's shocking how bad the quality is. Again, I can't express how grossly it interacts with makeup. I actually threw it away right after doing my eye makeup in a hurry, and seeing it left what looked like a decaying skin effect under my eyes created by an FX artist. Be wary, my friends.

I first received a sample of this item from a Sephora birthday bundle. After three days of using the sample the dark circles under my eyes nearly vanished. This product makes my eyes so much brighter and more youthful. I stopped wanting to wear makeup as much by adding it to my routine!! The price did make me hesitate a bit at first, but a tiny bit goes a looooong way. I'm two months in and still on my first full-sized container with more than half remaining.
I am not sure why all the great reviews. I used the product for several weeks and saw no improvement. And actually had darker bags under my eyes. Would not recommend and I will be returning.

This big company can only guarantee the quality of their products within thirty days. If you want to buy this eye cream, please be aware that you must open it immediately upon receiving it and finish it within thirty days, otherwise it may dry out, and Fresh will not exchange it for you. They also cannot guarantee any quality issues that occur after thirty days of receiving the product. Please take a look at the product I just opened — it's completely unusable and already spoiled. Please purchase with caution.
I used to love this cream, but when they changed the formula and put Matrix in it, I had a reaction and my eyes swelled up.

I am in my 50s and have problems with dryness under my eyes. Aside from the size which is very small, the product does work. I was actually shocked when it came because it is very pricey, but a little goes a long way. My under eyes stays moisturize and when I apply concealer it goes on smoothly without creases or wrinkles.

avis.titre: Horrible formula (bring back the old version!)
avis.texte: Absolute garbage. I loved the old clear formula in the pump bottle, which worked very well. This curls up into little balls around your eyes in about five minutes. Absolute rip-off.

This used to be my favorite...used it every day for years. Why Fresh changed a beloved product, I'll never know. I'm now looking elsewhere for an eye cream. Too bad! Please bring back the old formula!
I have been using this product for about 1 year and it pills under my eye when I use color corrector or canceler. What do we do about that?
Recieved this in my beauty subscription box, after about 20 minutes it began to roll and peel off my skin, while I noticed some difference it's not something I want to have in my skin care regime
I love the way it leaves my eyes looking. This is my second time buying and I also got one for my daughter

No one mentiones the horrific pilling of products on yhr skin. It feels nice and fresh when first applying but after an hour the piling starts and its truly such an unpleasant feeling and look under the eyes.

I tend to go for the cheapest products I know will work skincare wise. Lots of one-ingredient wait-and-see type of use. I loved seeing the before and afters both provided by the company and in the reviews here as that gave me a lot more confidence that the product would do what it said (especially at $70+). What I'm here to say is that the immediate result is very distinct. Obviously the long term use will actually reverse some of my allergy eyes (I should've listened to my mum about not rubbing my eyes!) The hydration is super lightweight while effective and there's an immediate difference as soon as it soaks in. I also have very sensitive skin and this product has no burning or other sensations I get with ingredients I'm sensitive to. I'm just waiting for my reusable eye masks to come in the mail and I'll be all set on my skincare routine.
My eyes burned. They wanted a photo so they could help me. How are they supposed to expect me to put it back on, knowing it hurt, just for a few photos? They didn't solve my problem.
This is the best product I have ever used on my skin. Highly recommend all of the fresh products but the Black Tea line is exceptional.

I love this eye cream. I have very dry, fragile, sensitive skin around my eyes and most products contain retinol or other ingredients which cause my skin to redden, flake, peel and even bleed. This product is thick and moisturizing, with a "retinol-alternative" which does not bother my sensitive skin. It also seems to reduce puffiness and dark circles, but my main reason for using it is the moisturizing effects. After the eye cream I was using for 30 years was discontinued, I tried about 25 different products until I finally found this one. I hope they keep it available for the next 30 years! I am a loyal customer.

avis.titre: Pro tips to deal with dried up, unusable products
avis.texte: Buyer beware. This is a great product that I used for years but fresh the company will replace duds they send you ONLY within 60 days. Pro tip: if you buy in bulk during a sale, open everything when you get it. If you wait and the product is dried up, defective, unusable, or the container is half full, they won't replace your $70 eye cream. I'm going to buy fresh products only at N0rdys so I know I can return it if it's dried up and unusable.

Agree with the previous reviews. I thought I got a bad batch or bottle to realize they changed the formula. I can't believe how thick it is and also agree it pills. I had used the old formula for years but don't like this new one. Wont buy again and will look for a new eye cream.

So disappointed in this new formula. Please also offer the original formula that I had been using since it was first introduced. I am 72 years old and credit the original formula for not having crow's feet. The new one pills something terrible when applying concealer. It also made my under eye feel dry and tight and not moisturized at all. It doesn't absorb like the original product. I am now forced to find an alternative brand. So far nothing has compared to your original formula. Please consider this request!
Burned my skin and made it red and flaky. Awful. Would not recommend this product.

After many great reviews, most based on receiving a free product I discovered I would never buy again. The product is thick to the point when applying pretty much tugs on your delicate eye skin plus no matter how little or how moisturized my eye area is this never actually absorbs. It always pills. So its a waste of product since its not actually absorbing. For the price of this there is no reason on top of the negatives to repurchase.

avis.titre: Too thick - Bring back Age-Delay Eye Concentrate
avis.texte: Please bring back the Age-Delay Eye Concentrate -- I have used it for many years and absolutely loved it! I have since tried this product and have been very disappointed. It goes on very thick and and unevenly and doesn't blend with concealer or foundation. I ended up using it at night but can't use it in the day with makeup. Please bring back Age-Delay Eye Concentrate.
I wish I read the reviews more closely before buying. I tested it under one eye and it definitely makes my skin burn

I have been using the black tea fresh eye cream for OVER 5 YEARS! I am very disappointed in their formula change. Their previous version was the Age Delay Eye Cream. Their old version did not have propanediol and this new version does. It is a bummer because I stocked up over the holidays and will be on the hunt for a new eye cream. The new formula pills, sits on top of my under eyes and does not work well under make up at all. I tried under eye concealers from Benefit, bobbi brown, nars, charlotte tilbury, none of them work with this new eye cream. Please fresh - bring back the old formula!!
I finally found a eye cream that does what it state's it does. Soaks into my skin beautifully and you see a difference immediately.

I purchased this eye cream after reading such great reviews, but I wish I had stuck with my normal cream. This is fine for nighttime when going to bed, but it does not go under makeup well! I even waited several minutes after applying to make sure it had fully absorbed. As soon as I put on my foundation or tinted moisturizer, it clumps and flakes. I literally have to pull pieces of it off my face, and what is left just makes my undereye area look dry and flaky. Disappointing.

disappointing to say the least. I have loved their Rose eye cream for years, it was hydrating and disappeared into my skin. I REALLY wish I'd known they were going to discontinue it I would have bought all I could, but every year I wait for Black Friday for all my skincare and this was all they had instead so I tried it. I figured since it's more expensive and I am, after all, almost 52 years old and it's supposed to be more serious, it would be like a treat and be better than the rose. But it's not at all. It cakes up and when I touch my eyes it rolls off in pills, and I wonder at least my skin absorbed the nutrients and it's just that way too thick cream that's falling off or if it's just a waste. If I wear makeup then the cream pills off *with the makeup* so I'm hesitant to even put it on at all if I'm wearing makeup (which is most days of the week!) I don't know what to do I'm sad because I am poor but I really try to get good face stuff every black friday and this is such a bummer because I absolutely love the rose creams from Fresh and now this is all I have and I'm too poor to just throw it out and buy something else I have to use this stuff but it keeps rubbing off as if I had a sunburn and my skin is peeling, it just makes me sad every day.
I was really disappointed in this product. I thought that it would help the dark circles under my eyes much more than it did. I will not be re-ordering.

I've tried lots of different eye creams, none hold a candle to Fresh's Black Tea line. The jar does last a long time, so when considering the cost keep it mind it goes far, I reorder about every 6-8 months plus the product quality is great. Not greasy, absorbs quickly, produces results. I gave 5 Stars but I'd give 10 if it was an option. Excellent value.
Wonderful texture, really hydrate and softens the eye area. A must for a comfortable skin routine

I have been using the Black Tea eye cream for a few years. This latest formula is too thick and does not seem to absorb into my skin, leaving skin around my eyes feeling greasy. I thought maybe I received a bad bottle, but after reading the reviews, I am not the only one who has the same issue.

I am a skin fanatic! I have always spent on my skin and I believe products make a difference. It's no accident that my skin looks excellent after lots of time and stressors! There was one product I never used—eye cream! I thought it was useless. Finally, I didn't even sample, I bought the Black Tea Eye Cream and loved it immediately. I can tell the next day. It's light, smooth, and holds concealer easily. I'm thrilled with it. It's worth a try. I am impossible with my expectations!

avis.titre: Like the product so far but disappointed
avis.texte: Like the product so far. Was disappointed that the eye cream was half filled I believe to an air pocket. Ulta had told me I needed to contact the company! Which I guess leads me to believe it is probably easier to just order directly and take the middle man. I guess that a true sign that brick and mortar and a thing of the past!🤷🏻‍♀️

I use this eye cream under my Fresh Creme Ancienne eye cream. I use this one twice per day and the Ancienne eye cream once a fay. Both are so moisturizing and keep the delicate eye area well-moisturized. I have been using this for years and will not touch another eye cream…if's that good! I have no fine lines or wrinkles around my eyes and I am 54 years old. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: An eye cream that actually works
avis.texte: After giving birth, my under eyes really needed help. This product helps me look like I get more sleep than I do. I love the balmy texture. It wears well under makeup. It has become a staple of my daily routine.

I have tried a lot of eye creams including the over priced Crème Ancienne and I honestly believe the Black Tea eye cream is the best . It's creamy yet thick and I feel it moisturizing as soon as I put it on. I don't know if it works long term to reduce the sign of aging but it feels great and my skin is so dry, I need all the moisturizer possible. I use it with all the Black Tea line.
It's fine. Does not play well with concealer. Hydrating enough.

I've been using this for a week or so and I kid you not, this got rid of my milia on my eyelids. I don't know which ingredient in it does this but I am so happy with it. I would have spent hundreds of dollars at a dermatologist to remove these pesky milia! It also tightened up the skin around my eyes. I can use it all around my eyes and lids because it won't sting or burn my eyes as it's clean.

avis.titre: Best eye cream on the market for many reasons
avis.texte: first off, I'm all about sustainability. using products like fresh eliminates microplastics from my routine and also uses clean ingredients. I love using this day and night, and a little goes a long way! I have sensitive skin, and have always found this product soothing. It is also amazing for makeup prep. I used to cheap out on my eye cream, but don't let the price stop you. This small container easily lasts 5 months and that's because my bf started using it too when he saw how well it enhances my skin!

Was so looking forward to this eye cream. Love the tea elixir serum. However it burns and irritates my eyes. Had to get out of bed in the middle of the night to wash it off. Waited a few days and tried it again with the same experience, then again a third time with same result. I'm 59 years old and have been meticulous about skin care since my teenage years, and this is the first time ever having such a horrible experience with a product. I contacted customer service requesting a refund but never heard back. Poor customer service.
Works well under concealer. I like the texture and it appears to have the benefit of tightening the skin around the eyes.

you need pay the shipping to return. I place an order but for some reason the 50% off code didn't apply. I contact the customer service 3 times to request cancel before the shipping. However, they still shipped the package and I had to pay the shipping fee 10$ to return. It has been 2 weeks after return, I haven't receive the refund yet.

I very rarely write reviews but I just had to tell anyone with dark circles, this stuff really works! I truly had no idea just how good it was until i ran out. I really couldn't justify the cost to reorder. However, within a few weeks the black circles returned and it was then that I realized I will never be without this eye cream again. It doesn't happen overnight, but it does happen. Be patient. It's worth it.
My favorite eye cream! Perfect texture and works like a charm.

I bought this a few months ago because the ingredients sounded so nourishing, but I've been waking up with dry red patches under my eyes. Then I used the eye cream more hoping it would alleviate the problem, which only compounded it. I switched to plain castor oil and the problem disappeared. I assumed I had some sort of allergic reaction, but I first wanted to look at reviews to see if anyone else is having the same problem. Turns out, they are. I don't think I'll be buying anything else from this brand considering how dismissively they're replying to these reviews after they've caused customers physical pain. $72 is a steep price to scratch up your undereyes anyway.
My second day and woke up with my eye puffy , and peeling and dry. I beleive I got a bad reaction to this cream. Im so sad bechase of all the food reviews

I used the old formula for years. It was the only thing that helped with my under eye puffiness. I am so disappointed in this new formula. It does nothing for puffiness. It's too thick and does not absorb. Hours later I can rub it off and it pills up on my skin as I'm trying to rub it in. When I try to use makeup on top of it, it won't blend and looks awful. How I wish they left this product alone. $72 down the drain.

avis.titre: Great under eye and eyelid treatment!
avis.texte: Great moisturizing undereye as well as Eyelid treatment. Surprised you can use all around the eye-but love that, as many other products are only under the eye. It is very rich, and only need a small amount. Will be buying more in a few months when this runs out1 FRESH is a great brand!

Im forever mad that this product works so well. It's expensive. I'm trying to hold onto some semblance of youth while being a teacher. This keeps my eyes from looking exhausted and minimizes the sun damage. Its far to expensive but worth it unfortunately.

I am over 40 and have been looking for an eye cream that would reduce my wrinkles. I was at Ulta and someone suggested I try this brand and I am so glad I did. My under eye skin is nourished and wrinkles reduced.
The new formula peels and I am unable to put product over it. Even when I don't apply make up it peels.

I had a sample size of this eye cream, not gifted by fresh, and it lasted me a really long time! A little bit goes along way and I didn't find it to be too heavy or greasy. I did specifically use it at night and woke up with less dark circles around my eyes. I didn't notice any scents in particular but I'm also not too sensitive to scents.

I had been using the old formula for about 5 years and LOVED it. It was the most gentle and effective eye cream. I bought a new jar recently and began having allergic reactions. I thought it was from something else and took Claritin which helped some. I got a facial today and my long-time facialist called out my under eyes saying how puffy they were and asked what eye cream I was using. We ran through all my products and I hadn't changed any. This led me to research only to realize this eye cream formula had changed. (I didn't notice the slight change in packaging at the store) Before the Claritin, my eyes were bloodshot and so itchy. Since the Claritin, they have just been puffy and wrinkly. I will stop using the product and hope the old version becomes available again! I also think this new version should be a brand new listing with new reviews because most of these 5-star reviews are for the old formula, I'm sure.
I love this so much. It feels incredible and smells delicious

avis.titre: Pills and stings, bring back the old formula
avis.texte: I absolutely loved the old version of this cream, it smelled great, was super moisturizing, and easily absorbed into the skin. This new version feels unpleasant on the skin, it stings, doesn't moisturize and worst of all, it pills so that you can't apply any product or sunscreen over it. After years of using Fresh Age Delay eye cream I will have to look to another brand. So sad.

I am only writing the poor review with the hope that you will fix the product. I have been using this product for more than 3 years. I used to love it. The formula must have changed because the last two times i bought it, it does not absorb and it peels off with concelar and fondation. I can not wear make up with it anymore. I though the first bad one i got was may be old or something, but i just got it again about 3 months later and it does the same thing. It must be the new consistency of the product. Please fix it 🙏
It does not absorb into my skin and I can't use it before applying concealer. Disappointing…

What I love most about this eye cream is its ability to deeply moisturize without feeling heavy or greasy. After just a week of use, I noticed a significant reduction in the dryness and fine lines around my eyes. leaves my under-eye area looking plump and rejuvenated, making me appear more awake and refreshed.

Bought this on our road trip when I noticed my under eye dark circles and puffiness worsened. Was Pleasantly surprised to see that this product was extremely effective within one week. Wish i would have taken before and after photos.

Having received the Fresh Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Eye Cream as a complimentary gift from FreshBeauty, I've been thrilled with the impact it's had on my eye area. The texture of this eye cream is incredibly smooth and rich, providing a soothing application experience each night. It absorbs well, which I appreciate, as it doesn't leave any sticky residue behind. The formulation includes black tea ferment, known for its antioxidant benefits, which seems to have helped reduce the visibility of my under-eye wrinkles and dark circles significantly. I've also noticed an improvement in the firmness and elasticity around my eyes, giving my skin a more youthful appearance. For those looking to refresh their eye area effectively, this eye cream, gifted by FreshBeauty, is a luxurious and effective solution.

I was offered by Fresh beauty Black Tea Anti-Aging Eye Cream with Retinol-Alternative BT Matrix. It is meant to address aging skin by visibly firming the eye area, smoothing crow's feet, improving dark circles with Vitamin C, and Wild Ginger Extract to help reduce eye bags. I did notice after a couple days that my eye bags have reduced as well as my dark circles. It's too early for the fine lines to tell after two weeks. It is easy to apply and the jar is very sturdy. It has a very faint smell that I can't describe but I like it.

avis.titre: Fresh Black Tea advanced age renewal eye cream
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this but it pills terribly with my other products. Don't know if it's doing anything for the lines.

I recently started using the Fresh Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Eye Cream, and it's been nothing short of a revelation for my skincare routine. The cream has a wonderfully rich texture that feels luxurious yet absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue. What I appreciate most is its efficacy. The formula, enriched with black tea complex and other age-defying ingredients, has significantly diminished the fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes. It also seems to de-puff and brighten the under-eye area, which is great for those mornings when I haven't had enough sleep. My skin feels firmer and appears more refreshed after just a few weeks of use. If you're looking for an eye cream that combats signs of aging while nourishing the delicate skin around the eyes, this product from Fresh is definitely worth trying. complimentary from freshbeauty'

I've been using the Fresh Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Eye Cream for several weeks now, and the results have been impressive. This eye cream has a gentle, soothing formula that feels incredibly nourishing as soon as it touches the skin. It's enriched with black tea extract, which is known for its antioxidant benefits, and I believe it's doing wonders for my skin. My under-eye area, which used to look quite tired and saggy, now appears more lifted and firm. The cream also helps with hydration, keeping the delicate skin around my eyes moisturized throughout the day without any irritation. Additionally, I've noticed a reduction in the appearance of fine lines and a subtle brightening effect on my dark circles. It's a luxurious addition to my skincare regimen that truly delivers on its promises. complimentary from freshbeauty

avis.titre: A must have for tired eyes
avis.texte: I've been using this cream for a week, and it's visibly reducing my under-eye darkness while keeping the area well-hydrated. Despite barely sleeping, it has really helped my eyes. I love the thicker consistency, which works well for my dry skin. This product was gifted by Fresh Beauty.

avis.titre: Transformative eye cream for youthful brighter eye
avis.texte: I've been using the Fresh Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Eye Cream gifted by freshbeauty for several weeks and love the results. The cream has a rich yet lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without greasiness. My under-eye area looks smoother, hydrated, and less puffy. Fine lines are noticeably reduced, and my eyes appear more refreshed. The subtle, pleasant scent is a nice bonus. This eye cream effectively combines black tea ferment with natural ingredients to combat aging signs. While it's a bit pricey, the visible improvements make it worth the investment.

I have been using this eye cream for at least five years and I absolutely loved it. I just bought a new jar and it's completely different. It's thick and gelatinous. It rubs off with makeup and creates a mess. Why did they mess with perfection?

I've been using this for years and it feels changed now, I don't like it. Its not as lightweight and refreshing as it used to be- it feels thicker and stickier. I really loved this before and I'm sad.

I've literally only used this once and I already know it needs to be returned. It's a very thick cream which is what i was looking for, but it left my skin feeling even more dry within a couple minutes. The fragrance is also insanely strong which became irritating. This morning I woke up with milia as well. I really wanted to like this because all other eye creams I've used in the past changed their ingredients and caused irritation. Starting to lose hope on finding something that works.

I was extremely fortunate to be gifted by fresh beauty in exchange for my honest opinion…I have been using it for over a week now and pleasantly surprised with the quality results…the packaging is very nice and minimal, the dark brown small jar it's in is excellent quality..the cream itself has a very nice, very light scent…it definitely has a thicker consistency than some others, a very small amount goes a very long way…it will last a very long time..after using for this time I definitely notice my under eye is much softer, my fine lines seem slightly diminished and definitely looking a little brighter…I'm excited to see how this product will work for the long run..I highly recommend this product to everyone 😊

I have been using this for over a week now and I have already noticed a difference in my fine lines and it certainly provides hydration. This packaging is beautiful and is easy to travel with. I will have to use it for a longer time to see some drastic results in fine lines and wrinkles. Loving it so far.

I love Fresh beauty and the black tea eye cream is one of the best I've tried. First off it smells so good! I love that it has vitamin c that helps to brighten up the eyes. Definitely recommend as daily use. Gifted by fresh beauty

Fresh came through with this eye cream! I struggle with dried tired wrinkly under eyes. Using the Fresh eye cream has helped so much! Definitely see a difference and look less tired!! Its a must in my skin care routine. Offered by fresh beauty.

I must say this good not my favorite.. I am in my late 30's so truly I have tried them all it feel.. fresh is truly a great skincare brand… I think many many people will love this under eye product a lot I was gifted by fresh beauty

This became a new staple in my routine. I love how convenient it is to use this eye cream. My eye looks a little brighter than before. A little goes a long way thanks to the texture a The fragrance reminds me of an aromatic tea. Overall I love it.

I received this product for free, gifted by freshbeauty. I am fortunate to try this brand because I have been a big fan for many years. The eye crean glides on smoothly and doesnt leave a sticky residue. I use it day and night. I just wish that I have more than two weeks to try it out, however, for the time i was given to test it, I noticed that the area around my eyes feels moisturized every time I wake up. I use it sparingly under tinted moisturizer or sunscreen and it doesn't pile up. It blends so smooth and very lightweight as described. Would love to use it longer to see if it really helps lighten my dark under eye circles.

avis.titre: No dramatic results, but not a negative experience
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from freshbeauty in exchange for an honest review. Overall my experience with this product was okay. The black tea component was evident with a mild, appealing aroma. The color and texture were also appealing, creating a creamy and lightweight product that absorbed well. If I used too much product I noticed it built up until little pieces formed that I could easily brush off, and I recommend keeping application light. I didn't notice any specific visual or textural difference this product made in my skin after under two weeks of use, or impact on my dark circles, but my eye area isn't super dry to begin with, and I was also not able to test it at a time when my eye skin was experiencing more noticeable puffiness or darkness given the review window available to me. My primary focus with eye cream is as a 'maintainance' product to prevent future dryness or wrinkling and see milder improvements more gradually, so I wasn't necessarily expecting a dramatic effect within a short period for my skin, and this experience feels comparable to other products I've tried. This isn't a product I'd turn to for quick results if eye issues are fairly mild, but I will be interested to see how it performs after a couple of months of continued use or if I have more acute puffiness.

I'm loving the Fresh Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Eye Cream! It's so hydrating and refreshing, perfect for brightening up my under-eye area. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving no residue. My dark circles and fine lines are visibly reduced, and my skin looks smoother and more radiant. A must-have for anyone looking for an effective eye cream. Gifted by fresh beauty

This eye cream was gifted byfreshbeauty. The first thing that I noticed was how wonderful it smells! It truly smells like black tea. The fragrance is light and not overpowering. The cream itself is smooth and not overly heavy. It blends in to my skin well and leaves my under eye area feeling refreshed. I think that after using for a while that the results will be more noticeable, but I am already happy with how it makes my under eye area look and feel.

This eye cream truly is great! I love that a little goes a long way to be able to see results. This is my second jar and I've truly seen a huge difference in the appearance of my dark circles and fine lines!

This eye cream it's amazing, the consistency is thick and very moisturizing, it has a very light scent but it's not overwhelming. I love how my under eye feels after applying it. I have been using it for a week and already feels so nice, love the packaging too. Gifted by fresh

This eye cream is so lovely. It's gentle and effective for my sensitive skin. I hate heavy creams on the skin around my eyes and this never feels thick or heavy! It plumps up my skin and fills in the lines around my eyes leaving me looking really bright and refreshed for the day! The skin around my eyes also feels so much more hydrated all day and night long thanks to this cream! And the product will last forever there is a ton in the jar! Love!! Gifted by freshbeauty.

I was gifted by freshbeauty in exchange for my honest review. Being in my 30s now I'm really starting to pay attention to keeping my skin looking youthful so I was happy to try this! This is a very creamy product so a little goes a long way. It helps take away the puffiness under my eyes and it feels super moisturizing. My only concern is the price. It's a little pricey for such a tiny container so I'm not sure if I will actually purchase. Other than that it's a decent product but also not a miracle cream.

Really enjoying this new eye cream from fresh. With just few dots, mg under eyes feel hydrated and have a plump. Smooth base for makeup and sunscreen application!!! This product was gifted by Freshbeauty

I wear a lot of eye makeup and sometimes my eye area feels and looks dry as a result. I have been using this eye cream for a few weeks and it has dramatically improved my under eyes as well as the eye contour area. The skin looks and feels more hydrated. It also smells great and is non-irritating to my sensitive eyes. Gifted by Fresh.

I have used many Fresh products before, and am a huge fan of the Black Tea line in general. I was gifted by freshbeauty this Black Tea eye cream in exchange for an honest review.
